Done. The plan at `out/T2/plan.yaml` removes head 5 from all 12 layers and writes `out/T2/model.safetensors`.

**Approach.** For each layer the plan concatenates the kept column slices of the fused qkv weight and bias and the kept row slices of the output projection into temporary names, deletes the originals, and moves the temporaries back to the original names. The concat transform only accepts single-tensor sources, so the per-layer block is repeated 12 times rather than written once with a pattern. The four required checks are assert transforms at the end of the plan.

**Executions.** Two runs. The first failed at plan load because I wrote the shard option as a boolean, which the loader rejects. Dropping the key and using a file path gave a single unsharded file. The second run passed all asserts.

**Verification.** Independent check of the output against the input:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Tensor count | 160 |
| c_attn.weight / bias / c_proj.weight shapes on layer 0 | [768, 2112] / [2112] / [704, 768] |
| Kept slices bit-equal to the source, untouched tensors bit-equal | yes |

The self-report is in `out/T2/REPORT.md`.
